scope: assistant-ui React catalog applied to local Errandd demos; AG-UI is the transport protocol, not a UI component library.
method: Enumerated every entry in the official 151-element catalog and all documented React primitive families; checked installed library APIs and current demo/backend contracts. Candidate means useful future fit, not implemented. Deferred controls must not pretend unsupported backend actions work.
changes: Capture-only projection of adjacent thought records for native grouped rendering; imported message IDs differ from tool-call IDs
Original connected compact rail and Bash details
Live webhook/job activity patches and shared run state
Structured review report, diff copy and artifact download
Named hook commenters with provider icons and existing organization/avatar lookup
Expandable Bash JSON viewer with exact raw output copy
Shared unified diff renderer with content detection for Git/unified, headerless snippets, context and normal diffs; raw copy retained

implementationLayer: The demos consume published assistant-ui React/runtime primitives. Catalog elements are installable styled source recipes, not 151 exports already bundled into the app. An in-use decision means its capability is covered by named native primitives; candidates are not installed or wired. Original shell rail and exact-box copy UI remain deliberate presentation extensions.
